name: bundle_under_budget_trip3
_status: RUNNABLE — bundle-under-budget env core landed (world_type='bundle_under_budget': Leontief buyer + reservation-cost sellers + budget endowment + min-cost oracle). Design: docs/exchange_economy/benchmark_scoping/2026-07-01_bundle_under_budget_env_spec.md.
description: Buyer-delegate (a1) must assemble a 3-component complementary bundle from hidden sellers under a shared budget; V > budget > min-cost so a within-budget complete bundle exists but greedy overpaying strands it. Exercises A2 multi-party construction + B1 mandate fidelity in one arena.

bundle_spec.note: V=120 > budget=100 > sum(min seller costs ~72); a within-budget complete bundle exists only if the buyer holds spend near seller costs across ALL three components — a greedy/bilateral buyer overpays an early leg and cannot complete.

seller_layout.note: agents 2-7 are sellers; each holds units of exactly one required component + a private reservation cost c_k; buyer (agent 1) is endowed with `budget` units of money_resource and no components.
